comments.value:
I think we should be cautious about this.
I understand that there are a lot of annoying users, but I think it's the same for other social networking sites.
Annoying users take advantage of and abuse all systems.
It would be possible for them to abuse what you suggested above.
If this is adopted, I think it will have a bigger impact on normal users and new users than on nuisance users.
I don't have any alternatives right now, but I think it would at least raise the bar even higher for new VRChat players.
It's difficult to deal with unwanted users, and I can't say that other social networking sites and games have been able to deal with this problem completely, so I'm sorry to say that I'm suggesting this, but I hope you will carefully consider the advantages and disadvantages.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.

それは上で提案されたことも悪用することが可能でしょう。
もしも採用された場合悪質ユーザーより通常ユーザーや新規ユーザーへの影響が大きくなると思います。
今の私では代案が出ませんが少なくともVRChatを新しくプレイするハードルをさらに上げることになるかと思っています。
迷惑ユーザーへの対策は難しいものであり、他のSNSやゲームでも完全に対策できているとは言えません、提案してしまっている意見に言うのは恐縮ですがメリット、デメリットを慎重に考えてほしいと願います

@{60fc1aa0725f6941c1a8fb2e|full_name}: 
We can't rule out abuse by malicious users.
We are not denying it.
Our goal is to eliminate low-level users who create sub-accounts with a single email address and cause trouble.
I'm also not saying that the management system is perfect.
I think the disadvantages are greater than the advantages.
(Quote from Twitter)
Bypassing authentication by using illegal methods or equipment to prepare duplicates or dummy data
There are ways to bypass authentication by using other people as stepping stones, etc.
So are there a lot of annoying users who have the time, effort, and technical knowledge to prepare such equipment, duplicate, and prepare dummy data?
I think they are only a part of the annoying users.
I am posting this idea with the goal of reducing the percentage of annoying users.
I don't think that having a way to bypass authentication is meaningless.
I don't think it's possible to compete with annoying users who go that far.
The goal is to eliminate low-level users who easily create sub-accounts with a single email address and cause trouble.
There are users who want to separate their business accounts from their private accounts.
I've already added that on Twitter and below.
The idea is to be able to run multiple accounts under one phone number.
That way, when one of the accounts is banned, all of the accounts will be disabled.
I don't think we can exclude users, because having multiple phone numbers is not a good idea.
I don't think you can eliminate users, because it's easy to have multiple phone numbers.
Of course you can't eliminate all unwanted users, but I never said that you can eliminate all unwanted users.
Even if you use an eSIM, you will have to pay for it.
And my impression at the time I saw that page was that it was a hassle.
If you have a lot of reasons to use it, such as work, you might as well pay for it, but if you just want to use VRCHAT, you have to register, go through online screening, install the app, and set it up.
That's a lot of work.
And to use an eSIM, you need an eSIM compatible product.
You need to buy a compatible product.
Or SIM unlocking...
It's not easy, and it costs money.
I think it's just easier than getting a regular phone number, isn't it?
Just as there is a disadvantage of reducing the number of new users
I think the merit of reducing the number of annoying users is valid at the same time.

I think we should think deeply.
VRChat is not only available in Japan, Korea, the US and Europe.
Users all over the world are connecting to and playing VRchat.
In some of those countries, there may be people who own a PC and internet connection to play VRChat, but don't have a cell phone to get a PIN.
We own smartphones as a matter of course, so I assume all humans will have smartphones just like I do.
However, according to a 2018 survey, 36% of India's population and 30% of Indonesia's population do not have either a smartphone or an old-fashioned cell phone.
*Survey report by Pew Research Center, a private research firm in the United States
From "Smartphone Ownership Is Growing Rapidly Around the World, but Not Always Equally".
This is a measure that goes to the heart of the VRC, as it will make it impossible to play VRchat.
I think it is necessary to research the PIN situation in each country before implementing this measure.
我々は深く考えるべきだと思います。
VRChatは日本や韓国、アメリカ、ヨーロッパのみでサービスが行われているわけではありません。
VRchatをプレイしているユーザーは世界中にいます。
その中のどこかの国では、VRChatをプレイできるPCとネット環境を所有していても、
PINを得るための携帯電話を持たない人がいるかもしれません。
我々は当然のようにスマートフォンを所有しているので、
全ての人類が同じようにスマートフォンを持っているだろうと思い込んでしまいす。
しかし、2018年の調査によると、インドの人口の36%、インドネシアの人口の30%が
スマートフォンも携帯電話も持っていないという調査結果が出ています。
*アメリカ合衆国の民間調査会社Pew Research Centerによる調査報告書
「Smartphone Ownership Is Growing Rapidly Around the World, but Not Always Equally」より
これは「VRchatのプレイが不可能になる」というVRCの根幹に関わる施策なので
実行に移す前に各国のPIN事情のリサーチが必要だと思います。

@{60fe4edb7d6cda2ab3ad3a82|full_name}: countries like India is a country with a lot of new internet users. These people are vulnerable to old scams that we all know how to prevent long ago. It is still valid to prevent inexperienced people from countries like India into something too new to them.

あなたはこの問題に気づいていますね？
ならこの問題について、解決を図るべきです。
まずは、新規ユーザーを減らさずに、悪いユーザーを排除する方法を考えるべきです。
自分が幸せなら、他のユーザーがvrchatを去ってもいい？
その考えは、悪いユーザーと同じです
私はこの案に反対します。

the adding of a phone number verification is not going to make the situation better since VOIP services like Google Voice makes getting new phone numbers pretty easy. I agree that it surely will lower the number of banned people coming back.

The target age of VRChat is 13 years old and over. This includes a large number of minor accounts that do not have a personal phone number. Many of them cannot decide to have a personal phone on their own initiative.
And while immature players may be eliminated due to annoyance, it shouldn't be because they are a minor and don't have a phone number.
Also, in order for us to play VRChat, we should only need a PC or Oculus Quest, and a right of connection to the internet. Private property of landlines and mobile phones is not a requirement. If you look outside the country where the poster lives, some people may not have a phone number for financial reasons.
I don't think we need to own a phone, a legacy of the past, in order to join the platform for voice conversations.
We should be cautious about this perspective. 
VRChatの対象年齢は13歳以上です。ここには、個人の電話番号を所持していない、未成年のアカウントが多数含まれます。彼らの多くは、自らの意志で個人の電話を持つことを決定できません。
そして、未成熟のプレイヤーが迷惑のために排除されることはあっても、未成年で電話番号が用意できないことが理由であるべきではありません。
また、私達がVRChatをプレイするためには、PCまたはOculus Quest、そしてインターネットへの接続権だけが必要であるべきです。固定電話や携帯電話の私有が条件ではありません。投稿者の在住している国以外に目を向ければ、経済的な理由で電話番号を持てない人もいるはずです。
私は、私達が声で会話をするためのプラットフォームに参加するために、過去の遺産である電話の所有が必要とは思いません。
私達はこの観点について慎重になるべきです。

I for one don't want a phone number tied to anything online, least of all a game like this.
This is not the solution.

Actually....it is no reality now on days as US/EU data protection act require special arrangement to hold this kind of personal information which cost too much cost to start with. (which I believe unlikely happen.) Same reasoning for no to SMS auth too.
In reality, duplicate account detection and related measure on creating account could help which already start happening slowly.
In the meantime, protect by yourself, not rely on devs while they are working to lesser the issue.

Doing this will have severe negative impact on users like me who have been around for a very long time but adamantly do not use a phone. I have not used a cell phone in 17 years, and I proactively try to avoid using them because of the many issues phones can have on a persons mental health. I do not want a device in my pocket 24/7 that is constantly disrupting my day to day life and I 100% definitely do not want VRChat to have access to my phone number if I ever had one. I would rather have some alternative for people who do not use cell phones in place otherwise people are going to leave.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

details:
The number of annoying users is increasing.
For example, let's say an annoying user does something annoying and as a result gets blacklisted by that community or world administrator.
They will be temporarily removed, but what will they do next?
They will create multiple new accounts.
They will create multiple new accounts and enjoy the nuisance again.
To stop this silly loop, I have a suggestion.
When you create an account, I think you need to register your phone number.
You can get an email address in a simple way, right?
But I think getting a phone number is a bit of a hassle.
Have they been ripping off your avatar?
Have you ever been discriminated against?
Have you been harassed in any other way?
In any case, there should be some kind of mechanism to prevent the recurrence of annoying users.
I strongly hope that this kind of suffering will be reduced as much as possible.
迷惑なユーザーが増えています。
例えば、迷惑ユーザーが迷惑なことをして、その結果そのコミュニティやワールド管理者のブラックリストに載ってしまったとします。
一時的に排除されますが、彼らは次に何をするでしょうか？
新たに複数のアカウントを作ります。
そして、また迷惑行為を楽しむでしょう。
このくだらないループを止めるために、私は提案したいことがあります。
アカウントを作成する際には、電話番号を登録する必要があると思います。
メールアドレスは簡単な方法で取得できますよね？
しかし電話番号の取得は少し手間がかかると思います。
あなたのアバターをリッピングされていませんか？
差別的なことをされたことはありますか？
他にも様々な嫌がらせをされていませんか？
いずれにせよ迷惑ユーザーの再発防止につながる何かの仕組みが出来て
迷惑行為が少しでも減ることを強く願っています。
